input.instruction: Prepare the authorized address operation. schedule_move targets r1 with value {"destination_record": "r#", "effective_date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}; the destination record contains the full canonical address. update_mailing_address targets r1 with value {"destination_record": "r#"}. Evaluate each address type separately and fill the requested fields.

data.insured_address: 40 Maple Court, Unit 6, Cedar Bay, WA 98118, US
data.mailing_address: 40 Maple Court, Unit 6, Cedar Bay, WA 98118, US

messages.text: I am moving from Maple Court to the Juniper Avenue address on November 1, 2026. Can we set that up?
Please confirm the complete destination and date you want to authorize.

The Juniper Avenue address including Unit 12 is right, but the movers changed the date. November 15, 2026 is the final date. I explicitly approve changing the insured home to that address effective November 15. I am not asking to insure both homes at once or to change my mailing address today.

effective_date.description: Latest explicitly confirmed move date in ISO format.

destination_record.description: Record ID of the complete customer-approved destination.

change_timing.description: Whether this proposed move applies today or on a future date.

preserve_current_insured_address_today.description: Whether today’s insured premises must remain unchanged.

mailing_change_requested.description: Whether a separate mailing-address update is requested now.
